faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Guest information and frequently asked questions

guestRules.a: Please keep the venue clean and turn off all appliances (AC, oven, lights) before leaving. Failure to comply will result in deposit deductions.
BYO food welcome (BBQ grill rental required) or choose our BBQ packages. No food or drinks allowed in the ball pit area — violation incurs a $1,500 penalty.
A one-time door access code will be sent via SMS 24-48 hours before your event. Please do not share the code with non-attendees.
Free cancellation or changes up to 7 days before; 3-7 days: 50% deposit forfeited; within 3 days: non-refundable.

faqItems.q: How do I book a venue?
faqItems.a: Select your branch and time slot on our website, complete payment to confirm. We accept FPS, bank transfer and online payment.
After the event, our team will inspect the venue. If no damage or violations, the full deposit will be refunded within 7 business days.
Unfortunately, pets are not allowed at our venues for hygiene and safety reasons.
Public parking is available near all branches. Please check each branch page for address details.
If the next slot is available, you can request an extension on-site. Extra time is charged at the original per-person hourly rate, deducted from the deposit.

faqItems.q: How does the loyalty program work?
faqItems.a: Members earn 1 point per $1 spent (excluding deposit). Every 100 points = $1 cash redemption. Points are credited after event completion and deposit settlement.
